node.statement: For the raw call furnished in node 1.1, lem-maincb-reset-invariant-preservation produces, without changing its source, target corner, or amplification form, a current reset isomorphism v_R:B_U oplus B_V->A_R with recorded ambient field epsilon_R and with d_R<=W.c0_cb*epsilon_R and ||v_R(I_{B_U oplus B_V})-u_{A_R}||<=W.c0_cb*epsilon_R. Since R=U union V, A_R=A_{U union V}, and epsilon_R=W.L*epsilon, this reset state is exactly the conclusion of node 1.
